mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies near Fireman Park with a temperature of 71 degrees. The moon phase is a waning crescent, and we have a treat tonight as the International Space Station will be visible at 9:05 PM for two minutes. It will rise over Mount Horeb in the southwest and head toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison, appearing about halfway up the sky.

Verona Police have arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019. The school district reported the information on August 30, and the investigation remains open at this time.

There is plenty to do in our community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is available today. Tomorrow is a busy day featuring the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, Paddy Mac's, The Mill, and The Bogey Factory, plus live music at Paddy Mac's. Also, mark your calendars for live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard this coming Friday.
Regarding the weekly report, the Verona Police Department made an arrest on Friday, September 4, related to an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30, involving a school staff member.
Culver's is serving up Georgia Peach as the flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
